lines.text: Moses says the LORD asks Israel to fear Him, love Him, serve Him with all their heart, and keep His commandments.
Israel's fathers went down to Egypt, seventy in all, and the LORD has now made them as numerous as the stars.
The LORD made the waters of the Red Sea engulf Egypt's army, and the earth swallowed Dathan and Abiram.
In the land, Israel is to proclaim the blessing on Mount Carmel and the curse on Mount Ebal.
If Israel obeys, the LORD promises rain in season and grass in the fields, so they eat and are satisfied.
